
# **Tipping Study - pt.2 Clean & prep data**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)

load(here::here("data", "proc", "01_out.rdata"))
```

#### Data

P's 23 & 24 clearly have to go

```{r}
dt[
  , .(
    n = .N,
    acc = round(
      mean(object_tipped == "target", na.rm = TRUE),
      digits = 2
    )
  ),
  participant
]

dt <- droplevels(dt[!participant %in% c("23", "24")])

# drop errors
dt <- dt[object_tipped == "target"]
```

Smooth positional data
---

Data dual-passed through a 4th order dual low-pass Butterworth filter
A 6 Hz cutoff was chosen because a biomechanist said that was the right thing to do.

###### Drop rough data

```{r}
# drop raw
raw_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
dt[, (raw_cols) := NULL]

# drop _smooth from smoothed
smoothed_cols <- grep("_smooth$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(dt, smoothed_cols, gsub("_smooth", "", smoothed_cols))
```

###### Translate

Origin is wherever they started.

```{r}
markers <- grep("_(x|y|z)", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

dt[, (markers) := lapply(.SD, \(axis) axis <- axis - axis[1]),
  by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num),
  .SDcols = markers
]
```

###### Get hand position

Treating the avg to represent hand pos. For left-hand reaches, x position is flipped, so that
positive values (for both hands) denote absolute distance from centre.

```{r}
invisible(
  lapply(
    c("x", "y", "z"),
    \(axis) {
      cols <- grep(paste0("_", axis, "$"), colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
      dt[, paste0("hand_", axis) := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
    }
  )
)

dt[hand_used == "left", hand_x := -hand_x]

# drop marker cols
dt[, (grep("^m\\d", colnames(dt))) := NULL]
```

---

```{r}
save(dt, file = here::here("data", "proc", "02_out.rdata"))
```
